claim.claim-text: 1. A method of operating a cellular module, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein operating using the first power level, the cellular module performs actions comprising: determining the time to activate the second power level of the one or more power supplies so that the second power level will be available in a just-in-time manner, to provide the cellular module with a power level required for reception and transmission.

3. The method of any of the preceding claims, additionally comprising: calculating a time-requirement for the one or more power supplies to transition from the first power level to the second power level, wherein the calculating is based on one or more factors comprising:
an age of a battery powering the cellular module; and a fixed period of time.
4. The method of any of the preceding claims, additionally comprising:

operating the cellular module using a third power level, wherein the third power level is greater than the first power level and less than the second power level, and wherein the third power level provides sufficient power to the cellular module to perform RF reception; and receiving time information, at the cellular module and from a remote cellular radio, while the cellular module operates using the third power level.
5. The method of any of the preceding claims, additionally comprising:

6. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the GPIO pin is a first GPIO pin, wherein the cellular module comprises the first GPIO pin and a second GPIO pin, and wherein the method additionally comprises:

signaling the one or more power supplies to transition from the first power level to the second power level, and signaling the one or more power supplies to transition from the second power level to the first power level, by operation of the first GPIO pin; and signaling the one or more power supplies to transition to a third power level, responsive to a signal via the second GPIO pin.
7. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the method additionally comprises:

8. One or more non-transitory computer-readable media storing computer-executable instructions that, when executed by the processor, configure the cellular module to perform actions according to any of the preceding claims.
9. A metering device, comprising: the one or more non-transitory computer-readable media storing computer-executable instructions of claim 8.
10. A metering device, comprising: the cellular module of claim 1.
11. A metering device, comprising:
12. The metering device as recited in claim 11, wherein the cellular module additionally comprises: a timer to indicate the time to activate the second power level of the one or more power supplies.

13. The metering device as recited in claims 11 or 12, wherein actions performed by the cellular module for determining the time to activate the first power level of the one or more power supplies are based at least in part on:
a threshold current value; and input of current values from a Coulomb counter.
14. The metering device as recited in any of claims 11 through 13, wherein the cellular module performs additional actions, comprising:

sending a second signal prior to conclusion of a communication that began at the appointed time, wherein the second signal indicates transition to a third power level that is lower than the second power level; and receiving the third power level in response to the second signal.
15. The metering device as recited in any of claims 11 through 14, wherein the radio comprises:

a transmitter, wherein a first signal from the GPIO pin results in receipt of the first power level at the cellular module, which is sufficient for the cellular module to power the transmitter; and a receiver, wherein a second signal from the GPIO pin results in receipt of power at the second power level at the cellular module that is sufficient to power the receiver, and wherein the second power level is insufficient to power the transmitter.
